text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — I'm assembling the pen-test + vuln-scan package for Acme Corp (they asked for per-control evidence and a remediation timeline). Need final bundle and timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Jordan Lee: Uploaded a first pass to S3: s3://redwood-shared/acme/poe-1763007890/ (report.pdf, scans/nessus.zip, proof-of-fix/). Lmk if anything missing. :link:
```
report.pdf
scans/nessus.zip
scans/qualys_report.json
proof-of-fix/screenshots/*
CAIQ-mapping.xlsx
```

vuln-scan-bot: Automated external scan complete — 3 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM, 12 LOW. See scans/nessus.zip and quick findings summary in report.pdf.

Tina Martinez: Thx. Do we have a SIG/CAIQ control mapping and a per-control owner? Customer specifically asked for evidence for controls: NET-04, CONF-02, ID-03.

Emily Zhou: I uploaded CAIQ-mapping.xlsx to the same folder. I mapped controls to artifacts and owners — short summary here:
- NET-04 -> rete-router config + firewall rules (owner: Raj Patel)
- CONF-02 -> S3 bucket policy + KMS audit (owner: Security-Infra team)
- ID-03 -> SSO audit logs + session token rotation doc (owner: Emily Zhou)

Raj Patel: Patch plan for infra nodes: kernel upgrades scheduled 2026-03-25 (maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC). App deploys to pick up library upgrades 2026-03-27. Target full remediation verification by 2026-03-28.

Alex Kim: Good. Customer also wants a short remediation timeline table and proof-of-fix screenshots + PR/issue links. Can we produce a 1-pager summary for legal? :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: Will produce sanitized proof-of-fix artifacts (no customer data). I can include PR links and diff snippets. Example snippet for PR links:
```
- https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4123 (kernel bump)
- https://git.redwood/app/PR-9876 (dep upgrade + test)
```

Emily Zhou: Quick remediation timeline (to include in 1-pager):
- 2026-03-25: Infra kernel patch applied to infra pool A
- 2026-03-26: Regression tests and canary verification
- 2026-03-27: App release with patched deps to 100%
- 2026-03-28: Post-fix external scan + QA sign-off
- 2026-03-29: Final evidence package delivered to customer (including signed attestation)

Tina Martinez: I'll answer the CAIQ questions and attach the completed CAIQ PDF to the folder. Also adding a controls matrix that maps to the pen-test findings.

Alex Kim: Please also include a scoped pen-test statement (what was in/out), the executive summary redacted for customer, and a signed attestation from security. Legal needs the attestation before we send.

Jordan Lee: Noted. I'll add attestation-placeholder.docx and label it "pending-signature".

vuln-scan-bot: Reminder — re-run external scan after fixes: scheduled for 2026-03-28 06:00 UTC.

Raj Patel: One open item — one HIGH was a third-party lib requiring vendor patch (no in-house fix). We have vendor timeline of 7 days; will include mitigation steps (WAF rule + IPS signatures) in the package.

Emily Zhou: For the vendor-patched issue we will include: (1) timeline (vendor ETA), (2) temporary mitigation rules, (3) monitoring playbook + detection queries.

Alex Kim: Great. I'll coordinate with @customer-sales to set expectation that final package goes out 2026-03-29 pending signature. If anything slips, we communicate the mitigation and vendor ETA.

Tina Martinez: Added CAIQ, controls matrix, and the CAIQ answers doc to the folder.

Jordan Lee: Final checklist I'm uploading now:
- [x] report.pdf (redacted)
- [x] scans/ (nessus + qualys)
- [x] CAIQ-mapping.xlsx and CAIQ.pdf
- [x] proof-of-fix (screenshots + PRs)
- [x] remediation-timeline-1pager.pdf
- [ ] signed-attestation.docx (pending)

Alex Kim: Awesome. Once attestation is signed I'll send the package to Acme and mark the deal packet complete. Thanks team :tada:

Jordan Lee: Ping me if customer asks for additional artifacts (e.g., raw logs). We can redact and provide on a case-by-case basis.

Emily Zhou: I'll run the post-fix scan and attach verification screenshots when complete.

Alex Kim: Closing out this thread — will follow up with confirmation after send.
